claims.claim: Fairly used singer sewing machine for sale!
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies an antique-style cast-iron treadle sewing machine; brand/model (including “Singer”) is not readable or confirmed.
Witness notes many key parts/accessories are not shown (bobbin case/shuttle/needle/presser feet/attachments; included accessories).
No proof of functionality is shown (no clip of treadle/handwheel operation, timing, or smooth movement).
A presser foot/needle bar area and ornate frame are visible, but the specific presence/condition of a “flat plate” is not clearly confirmed.
No brand/origin markings are readable in the witness report.
Witness report shows a treadle-style machine; whether there is a motor/electric conversion is not shown.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: Accessories/manual are not shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history evidence is shown; condition/rust/mechanical smoothness is not demonstrated.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete internal parts (bobbin case/shuttle/needle/presser feet/attachments) that affect usability and value.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the bobbin case/shuttle installed, needle installed, presser feet set, and a laid-out inventory of included attachments/accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts may be missing; treat as for parts or non-guaranteed completeness.

risks.risk: Mechanical condition issues (rust, cracks, bent needle bar, seized gears/timing/alignment) even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Video of handwheel rotation and treadle action with the needle bar moving correctly (timing/alignment), plus close-ups of rust/cracks at joints and the underside/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case: likely needs cleaning/repair; assume not smoothly working.

risks.risk: Belt/pulley or drive mechanism problems (treadle belt, pulley alignment, tension) that prevent smooth operation.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the belt/pulley area and a short clip showing the belt/pulley driving smoothly during treadle use.
risks.if_unproven: Price as drive may be worn or needs replacement.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch or misrepresentation (e.g., not actually Singer/Japanese) affecting resale value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of any brand/model plate, serial number, and markings on the head/flat plate area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic treadle sewing machine (no premium for brand).

risks.risk: Motor/electric conversion claim may be false or untested; if present, it may be faulty.
risks.proof: Photos of the motor (if any), wiring, switch, and a clip showing motor operation (or confirm no motor exists).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-electric treadle-only; do not pay for motor functionality.

risks.risk: Transport/size/weight uncertainty and potential damage risk due to cast-iron heaviness.
risks.proof: Measurements and weight (or at least dimensions) and photos of the base/legs for cracks and stability.
risks.if_unproven: Price with added risk for heavy/fragile transport and possible hidden damage.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the brand/model plate and any serial number/markings on the head and flat plate area.
Video: treadle action + handwheel rotation showing smooth movement and correct needle bar timing/alignment.
Photos/clip showing the bobbin case/shuttle installed and working with the needle/presser foot.
Close-ups of rust level, cracks, missing screws/parts, and underside/hinges/joints.
Photos of the belt/pulley/drive mechanism and a short clip demonstrating the drive under motion.
Inventory photos of all included accessories and the original manual (laid out).
If a motor exists: photos of the motor, switch, wiring, and a clip proving it runs.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a treadle-style antique cast-iron sewing machine on a stand, so it can be priced at its worst-case value for an unverified working condition and potentially incomplete accessories/brand. Seller claims (Singer/Japanese, complete set, motor/manual) are not verifiable from the provided report.
